examples.solution_text:
Write both sides with base $7$, then equate the indices.
$\begin{align*}7^{x}&=7^{3}\\x&=3\end{align*}$

Write the reciprocal using a negative index.
$\begin{align*}5^{x}&=\frac{1}{5^{4}}\\5^{x}&=5^{-4}\\x&=-4\end{align*}$

Rewrite both sides with base $5$, retaining the negative index.
$\begin{align*}(5^{2})^{-x}&=5^{3}\\5^{-2x}&=5^{3}\\-2x&=3\\x&=-\frac{3}{2}\end{align*}$

Rewrite both sides with base $2$. Multiply through every term in each bracketed index.
$\begin{align*}2^{2(x+2)}&=2^{3(2x-1)}\\2^{2x+4}&=2^{6x-3}\\2x+4&=6x-3\\7&=4x\\x&=\frac{7}{4}\end{align*}$

Express the right-hand side as a power of the same fractional base.
$\begin{align*}\left(\frac{3}{7}\right)^{2x+1}&=\left(\frac{7}{3}\right)^{2}\\\left(\frac{3}{7}\right)^{2x+1}&=\left(\frac{3}{7}\right)^{-2}\\2x+1&=-2\\2x&=-3\\x&=-\frac{3}{2}\end{align*}$

Convert the root to a fractional index and use base $7$.
$\begin{align*}7^{2x}&=(7^{3})^{\frac{1}{3}}\\7^{2x}&=7^{1}\\2x&=1\\x&=\frac{1}{2}\end{align*}$

Rewrite the decimal as a fraction first.
$\begin{align*}2^{x}&=\frac{1}{16}\\2^{x}&=2^{-4}\\x&=-4\end{align*}$

Use base $3$, then add the indices of the multiplied powers.
$\begin{align*}3^{5x}\times3^{2(-2x+1)}&=3^{4}\\3^{5x}\times3^{-4x+2}&=3^{4}\\3^{x+2}&=3^{4}\\x+2&=4\\x&=2\end{align*}$

Use base $5$, then subtract the denominator's index from the numerator's index.
$\begin{align*}\frac{5^{2n+4}}{5^{n}}&=5^{3}\\5^{(2n+4)-n}&=5^{3}\\5^{n+4}&=5^{3}\\n+4&=3\\n&=-1\end{align*}$

coverage.summary: Authored 11 worked examples covering all distinct assessed methods using changed values and supplied booklet methods. Each has separate editable question and solution fields, aligned full equations and plain explanatory prose that inherits the renderer's blue. No bare-expression continuation requires a phantom equals gutter. Diagrams add no instructional value to these algebraic examples. Practice and quiz mathematics were neither altered nor re-audited. Independent review of the new examples and actual visual capture remain coordinator stages; no files were written.

examples.derivation: Changing to base 2 gives indices 2x+4 and 6x-3. Equating them gives 7=4x, hence x=7/4.
49^x=7^(2x), while the cube root of 343 is (7^3)^(1/3)=7. Thus 2x=1 and x=1/2.
9^(-2x+1)=3^(-4x+2). Multiplication gives 3^(x+2)=3^4, so x+2=4 and x=2.
25^(n+2)=5^(2n+4). Dividing by 5^n gives 5^(n+4)=5^3, so n+4=3 and n=-1.
